name: com.patterns.character
description: Game-ready, drop-in character framework: pluggable movement abilities (walk, run, sprint, crouch, jump, dash, fly, swim, ladder, glide), a full camera suite (first person, third person orbit, top-down/isometric, 2.5D follow, fixed), animation/audio drivers and an editor rig wizard. Works with zero setup, no third-party packages, and supports both the legacy Input Manager and the new Input System.

samples.description: Script-only examples: build a character in code, add custom abilities, and switch camera modes at runtime.
